about_the_game:
Rise above the desert and build your kingdom.
Serve the travelers of the Silk Road, earn fame and fortune.
Ride freely across the oasis.
Defend your beautiful realm—until its inevitable fall beneath the shifting sands of fate.

Fast-Paced City Building Survival

Loulan Kingdom is a fast-paced city-building survival game set in a mysterious desert oasis.
Forget chopping trees and mining stones — instead, expand your kingdom by earning fame and leveling up to get new buildings.
Roads and walls automatically adapt and expand as you build, freeing you from tedious micromanagement, so you can focus on what truly matters: trade, defense, and survival.

The Silk Road

As the crossroads between the Central Plains and the Western Regions, Loulan welcomes all kinds of travelers:
commoners, merchants, refugees, monks, wandering heroes…
They bring wealth, stories, and opportunities.
Meet their needs, grow your fame, and make tough choices.

Defend Against the Desert’s Wrath

When night falls, danger awakens.
Savage beasts, roaming bandits, and ambitious neighbors threaten your fragile peace.
As Loulan’s fame spreads across the lands, greater powers will come knocking—
the fierce Xiongnu and the mighty Empire of the Central Plains.
Build your army, strengthen your walls, and deploy clever strategies to survive against overwhelming odds.

Heroes of the Desert

The mystic kingdom of Loulan attracts extraordinary souls—
wandering swordsmen, noble scions, and other figures of legend.
Forge bonds with them, earn their trust, and enlist their aid.
Together, you may yet defend your kingdom against the desert’s eternal silence.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10, 11 (64 bit)
  • Processor: 3.5 GHz
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060/AMD Radeon RX 6500 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10, 11 (64 bit)
  • Processor: 4 GHz
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 2060/AMD Radeon RX 6600
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 4 GB available space

short_description: Loulan Kingdom is a city-building survival and real-time strategy game. As the ruler of Loulan, you must build your city amid a perilous desert oasis, grow your power through the Silk Road, and fight to protect your kingdom—until the very end.
